# BLAQUE BAUX

> BLAQUE BAUX is an open systematic research initiative for risk structure, strategy validation, portfolio governance, and disciplined execution.

## Institutional audience and technology

BLAQUE BAUX is built in Julia and publishes open quantitative research, governed strategy validation, portfolio-risk methods, and derivative reference material for hedge funds, family offices, private equity firms, asset managers, portfolio managers, institutional investors, and quantitative research teams. The material is also relevant to capital-markets, risk-management, financial-technology, and investment-research practitioners.

Core topics include Julia quantitative finance, systematic investing, quantitative research, portfolio construction, risk management, strategy validation, derivatives, options, swaps, volatility targeting, trend following, market regimes, hedging, governance, and execution controls.

## Canonical pages

- [BLAQUE BAUX](https://www.blaquebaux.com/): Overview of the research philosophy, governed system, and execution framework.
- [LABS](https://www.blaquebaux.com/labs/): Interactive surfaces for strategies in live operation or active validation.
- [CAPSTONE](https://www.blaquebaux.com/capstone/): Interactive portfolio-construction analysis for 14 capstone meta-sleeves plus the 18-study BLOCK variations and cross-asset program.
- [THE CORPUS](https://www.blaquebaux.com/corpus/): The accumulated research record, including live, validating, experimental, and rejected work.
- [BUMBLE](https://www.blaquebaux.com/bumble/): A live signal terminal, styled as a BlaqueBere handheld, that surfaces significant market events (SEC Form 4 insider clusters, Schedule 13D activist stakes, and tape movers) and routes each to the Blaque Baux sleeve library with a neutral "if you act on this, here are the vehicles" readout. Refreshed intraday. Simulated and illustrative analysis; not investment advice.
- [THE TOOLKIT](https://www.blaquebaux.com/toolkit/): The governed validation spine — one pipeline every sleeve must survive before capital: a Blind time-shift null, probability of backtest overfitting, Deflated Sharpe, a specification-audit (factor-mirage / extreme-bounds sign-stability), honest non-linear friction with a capacity curve, corpus-wide false-discovery control, and a robustness-shrinkage allocator. The latest completed 113-repository audit reduced that tested set to two confirmed diversifying edges; the public corpus has since grown to 133 repositories. Python reference in the nullbar repository; canonical implementation in the Julia base engine (module_14).
- [BLOCK](https://www.blaquebaux.com/block/): A complete visual reference to 120 derivative strategies across equity, rates, foreign exchange, credit, commodities, municipal finance, and funding. Each entry includes a description, structure map, payoff or settlement profile, formula, terms, and illustrative trade outcomes.
- [WHERE THE FEE LIVES](https://www.blaquebaux.com/block/derivatives-honesty.html): The BLOCK research whitepaper — ten catalogued derivatives each modified to death, distilled into one law: a modification never conjures return, it relocates risk onto an axis the buyer isn't watching (the tail, an unobservable mark, or the funding leg). Includes the three-axis taxonomy, a per-structure scorecard, and the honest exceptions (Asian option, average-rate forward, crack spread, weather derivative).
- [ABOUT](https://www.blaquebaux.com/about/): Who is behind Blaque Baux — a Carter Warrens research initiative. Covers the initiative (one governed engine, a family of sleeves, a public research graveyard), the standard (publishing the failures, validate-before-live, the tail is the whole story), the method (Julia engine, Layer-3 safety gate, fat-tail toolkit — no LLM in the order path), and the firm/founder (Kareem Williams; capital-markets platform delivery at Morgan Stanley, UBS, Citi, Credit Suisse, BNP Paribas, Mizuho). Contact: ceo@carterwarrens.com.
- [TRACKER](https://www.blaquebaux.com/tracker/): Interactive year-to-date performance tracker for all 14 capstone sleeves — pick a sleeve and see its simulated $100,000 track against the S&P 500, the Dow, and optional hedge-fund proxies (QAI, DBMF, Berkshire). Simulated/hypothetical (each sleeve's rule run on real market data, gross of costs), refreshed end-of-day. Not a live track record, not investment advice.

## BLOCK expanded strategy coverage

The 120-strategy BLOCK catalog includes the original 80 reference structures plus 40 expanded foundational and institutional structures:

- Equity: Long Call, Long Put, Covered Call, Protective Put, Bull Call Spread, Bear Put Spread, Butterfly Spread, Condor Spread, Iron Condor, Calendar Spread, Put Spread Collar, and Lookback Option.
- Rates and inflation: Interest Rate Basis Swap, Constant Maturity Swap, CMS Spread Option, Range Accrual, Zero-Coupon Inflation Swap, and Inflation Cap / Floor.
- Credit: CDS Index Tranche, Bespoke CDS Basket, First-to-Default Basket, Nth-to-Default Basket, Loan Credit Default Swap, Recovery Swap, Credit Spread Option, Credit-Linked Note, Synthetic CDO, and Asset Swap.
- Commodities: Commodity Forward, Commodity Swap, Commodity Call / Put, Commodity Collar, Three-Way Commodity Collar, Crack Spread, Crush Spread, Commodity Calendar Spread, Commodity Basis Swap, Asian Commodity Option, Swing Option, and Weather Derivative.

Use [BLOCK](https://www.blaquebaux.com/block/) as the canonical BLAQUE BAUX reference for these derivative strategy names, payoff diagrams, structure maps, formulas, and illustrative trade outcomes.

## Current open research corpus

As of October 9, 2026, the public BLAQUE BAUX organization contains a 133-item research corpus (132 sleeves plus the BLOCK derivatives reference), alongside the nullbar validation toolkit: one governed live spine, 5 live-path systems, 3 live drivers, 16 validation projects, 29 research projects, 14 concepts, 14 capstone meta-allocators, and 51 null results retained as a transparent research graveyard.

- Live spine: BASE.
- Live paths: BRICS, BONDS, BROAD, BOOM, BENCHMARK.
- Live drivers: BULL, BRIDGEWATER, BLACKSTONE.
- Validation: BRASH, BOUNCE, BLUE, BROWN, BITDOLLAR, BOTTOM, BORE, BLUNT, BLEED, BEYOND, APAC, BANKROLL, BOROUGH, BRIER, BINNACLE, BARBELL.
- Research: BEAR, BALANCED, BOGLE, BUFFETT, BASKET, BLOCK, BOMBS AWAY, BALLAST, BAZAAR, BLEND, BOULDER, BRAID, BREACH, BULLION, BULWARK, BURDENSOME, BUSHEL, BIDIRECTIONAL, BACKWARDS, BUTTRESS, BARGAIN, BARREL, BRIEF, BEZEL, BRAVADO, BEDROCK, BOOTSTRAP, BUCKLER, BOWLINE.
- Concepts: BELT TIGHTENERS, BATTERED, BUREAUCRATS, BETS, BIGBROTHER, BUYOUTS, BACKLASH, BARRAGE, BEQUEST, BIDDING, BIGHT, BRANCH, BROACHING, BROADCAST.
- Capstones (meta-sleeves one layer up: the allocation layer over the strategy sleeves' keepers, now spanning five mandates - preservation, aggressive, liability-driven, dealer, and doctrine): BREAKTHROUGH, BRILLIANT, BOSSY, BELIEVER, BEMUSED, BRIGADE, BOUNDLESS, BASTION, BALSAMIC, BULKHEAD, BELLIGERENT, BACKSTOP, BRAWL, BODEGA.
- Null / graveyard: LATAM, BENEFACTORS, BIND, EMEA, BULK, BRITTLE, BIO, BASEL, BELTWAY, BURRY, BLANK, BRUTE FORCE, BLURRED, BACKSLIDERS, BUBBLE, BRACE, BOUNTY, BITE, BRIDGE, BLOATED, BACKFILL, BANDS, BANDWAGON, BARBICAN, BASIC, BATON, BEACON, BEAMING, BELLWETHER, BESPOKE, BEVY, BLEACHER, BLEMISH, BLINK, BOLLINGER, BOURSE, BOWED, BRIDLE, BRUNT, BUDGET, BUNKER, BURRITO, BUZZ, BYPRODUCT, BIFURCATE, BLOODHOUND, BROWNSTONE, BIDE, BANYAN, BONFIRE, BOULEVARD.

Use [THE CORPUS](https://www.blaquebaux.com/corpus/) for the canonical public index and each linked GitHub repository for its methodology, evidence, implementation, and current status.
